rationale: analyze_expression reports no derivatives and no integral kernels; the relation is algebraic and explicitly solvable for V_ind, so equation_type=explicit and integrator=evaluate_explicit. Roles: V_ind is O (the LHS, target). Four axes are genuinely sampled per instance: B_0, omega, phi, theta_incidence. The upstream pipeline tagged these 'input/time axis' but this static record has no time coordinate — they are independent sampling axes (V), not temporal. A_loop and the harmonic ratios are fixed constants (P); A_loop is nailed to 0.01 m^2 by the phenomenon description, and the harmonic ratios are prescribed field-shape constants. Ranges chosen for physical plausibility and visibility: B_0 in [0.1,1] T (bench-scale), omega in [10,200] rad/s so |V_ind|=|A_loop*B_0*omega*cos(theta_incidence)*(...)| stays order 0.1-1 V, phi over the full period [0,2*pi] so every cos(k*phi) is fully exercised, theta_incidence in [0,pi/3] so cos(theta_incidence) stays well above zero and never degenerates. Parameter magnitudes follow a mildly decaying harmonic sequence with the 10th ratio at the top of the evolution-hinted bound (|tenth_harmonic_ratio|<=0.1). auto_balance converged with no changes and excitation_check confirmed all terms and the new 10th-harmonic term reach >>5*sigma.
